description: Current gas price, base fee, priority fee, block fullness and the cost of a native transfer (21k gas) and an ERC-20 transfer (65k gas) in the native coin, for base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, gnosis and celo (or one chain with ?chain=). Price: $0.001 USDC on Base per call, paid with x402 (MCP transport: an unpaid call returns the x402 PaymentRequired object; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over HTTP: GET /api/gas-now.
name: gas_now
title: Gas snapshot on 8 EVM chains
